name: dreame-vacuum-3d
description: Home Assistant integration for Dreame robot vacuums (local miIO control, Xiaomi cloud for maps), with a three.js card that draws the robot moving through a 3D model of the house.
description_good_justification: The README's first paragraph: a Home Assistant integration for Dreame robot vacuums, with a 3D card. https://github.com/dortizesquivel/dreame-vacuum-3d#readme
interact_justification: The README explains how to install it (HACS or manually), configure and use it. Feedback goes through GitHub issues, contributions through pull requests (https://github.com/dortizesquivel/dreame-vacuum-3d/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md).
contribution_justification: Issues and pull requests on GitHub, as https://github.com/dortizesquivel/dreame-vacuum-3d/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md explains.
contribution_requirements_justification: https://github.com/dortizesquivel/dreame-vacuum-3d/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md: the CI must pass (ruff, mypy, the translations check, pytest with a coverage floor and Hypothesis fuzzing, ESLint, the card's unit and browser tests, HACS and hassfest validation, CodeQL), new functionality comes with tests, docs follow the change, style rules.
floss_license_justification: The MIT license is approved by the Open Source Initiative (OSI).
floss_license_osi_justification: The MIT license is approved by the Open Source Initiative (OSI).
documentation_basics_justification: The README covers requirements, installation, configuration, the 3D card, models, services, events, options and development: https://github.com/dortizesquivel/dreame-vacuum-3d#readme
documentation_interface_justification: The external interfaces are the config flow and options, the entities, the services, the events and the card's configuration, each documented in the README: https://github.com/dortizesquivel/dreame-vacuum-3d#configuration, https://github.com/dortizesquivel/dreame-vacuum-3d#services, https://github.com/dortizesquivel/dreame-vacuum-3d#events, https://github.com/dortizesquivel/dreame-vacuum-3d#the-3d-card
repo_public_justification: Repository on GitHub, which provides public git repositories with URLs.
repo_track_justification: Repository on GitHub, which uses git. git can track the changes, who made them, and when they were made.
repo_interim_justification: Every change goes through a public pull request and lands on the public main branch between releases.
repo_distributed_justification: Repository on GitHub, which uses git. git is distributed.
version_unique_justification: Each release has a unique version vX.Y.Z, in manifest.json, the git tag and the GitHub release.
version_semver_justification: Semantic Versioning: the release workflow bumps patch, minor or major.
version_tags_justification: The release workflow tags every release in git (vX.Y.Z): https://github.com/dortizesquivel/dreame-vacuum-3d/tags
release_notes_justification: https://github.com/dortizesquivel/dreame-vacuum-3d/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md and the notes of each GitHub release.
release_notes_vulns_justification: No publicly known vulnerabilities have been fixed so far. Fixes will be named in the release notes and in a GitHub security advisory (https://github.com/dortizesquivel/dreame-vacuum-3d/blob/main/SECURITY.md).
report_responses_justification: No bug reports have been filed so far; the maintainer watches and answers the issue tracker (https://github.com/dortizesquivel/dreame-vacuum-3d/issues).
enhancement_responses_justification: No enhancement requests have been filed so far; the maintainer watches the issue tracker (https://github.com/dortizesquivel/dreame-vacuum-3d/issues).
report_archive_justification: GitHub issues are public and searchable: https://github.com/dortizesquivel/dreame-vacuum-3d/issues?q=
vulnerability_report_private_justificati: SECURITY.md asks for reports through GitHub private vulnerability reporting (https://github.com/dortizesquivel/dreame-vacuum-3d/security/advisories/new); it still has to be enabled in the repository settings.
vulnerability_report_response_justificat: No vulnerability reports have been received so far; SECURITY.md commits to acknowledging within 7 days and assessing within 14.
build_justification: The integration is Python, loaded as it is. The card is bundled from card/src with three.js by esbuild (npm run build); CI checks the committed bundle is built from the source.
build_common_tools_justification: npm and esbuild for the card; packaging is a short Python script (scripts/release.py package).
build_floss_tools_justification: Node.js, npm, esbuild, Python, pytest, ruff, mypy, ESLint and Playwright are all FLOSS.
test_justification: pytest tests in tests/ (with pytest-homeassistant-custom-component), node:test unit tests and Playwright browser tests of the card in card/test/, documented in the README: https://github.com/dortizesquivel/dreame-vacuum-3d#development
test_invocation_justification: pytest (integration); npm test and npx playwright test (card).
test_most_justification: CI enforces a coverage floor of 95 % of lines and branches of the integration; unit and browser tests cover the card.
test_policy_justification: https://github.com/dortizesquivel/dreame-vacuum-3d/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md: new functionality must come with tests.
tests_are_added_justification: Features and fixes come with tests, for example https://github.com/dortizesquivel/dreame-vacuum-3d/pull/22 and https://github.com/dortizesquivel/dreame-vacuum-3d/pull/23.
warnings_justification: ruff (pycodestyle, pyflakes, bugbear, bandit, pyupgrade and more), mypy and ESLint's recommended rules run in CI.
warnings_fixed_justification: CI fails on any ruff or mypy finding or ESLint warning (--max-warnings 0), and the code has none.
warnings_strict_justification: ruff with a broad rule set including bandit's security rules, mypy with check_untyped_defs, and ESLint with zero warnings tolerated.
know_secure_design_justification: The primary developer knows the principles of secure design and applies them here: least privilege (local miIO first, cloud only for login, maps and fallback; read-only workflow tokens), fail-safe defaults (auth failures lead to reauth, a bad map frame keeps the last map), redaction by default in diagnostics, open design. See https://github.com/dortizesquivel/dreame-vacuum-3d/blob/main/docs/ASSURANCE.md#design-principles-applied
know_common_errors_justification: The primary developer knows the common errors behind vulnerabilities in this kind of software and how to counter them: exposure of secrets (redacted diagnostics, no secrets in entity states), untrusted input (the map decoder checks sizes and is fuzzed), XSS (room names reach the card as text, never as HTML), supply chain (actions pinned to commits, attested releases). See https://github.com/dortizesquivel/dreame-vacuum-3d/blob/main/docs/ASSURANCE.md#common-weaknesses-countered
crypto_published_justification: The integration chooses no cryptography of its own: it speaks the protocols the robot and Xiaomi impose (miIO: AES-128-CBC with the 16-byte device token; Xiaomi cloud: HTTPS plus SHA-256-derived RC4 keys on request fields), with the Python standard library and the cryptography package. All are published algorithms.
crypto_call_justification: AES comes from the cryptography package, hashes and random numbers from the Python standard library, TLS from Home Assistant's aiohttp session. Only RC4, which the Xiaomi cloud protocol requires, is a few lines in protocol/cloud_crypto.py, tested against recorded replies.
crypto_floss_justification: Python, the cryptography package and aiohttp are FLOSS.
crypto_keylength_justification: The keys are fixed by the protocols: 128-bit AES keys for miIO and 256-bit RC4 keys derived per request with SHA-256 for the cloud, inside HTTPS.
crypto_working_justification: The weak algorithms used (MD5 in miIO, RC4 in the Xiaomi cloud) are required to interoperate with the robot and Xiaomi's servers; the cloud traffic is also inside HTTPS.
crypto_pfs_justification: Cloud requests use HTTPS through Home Assistant's aiohttp session, whose TLS settings negotiate forward-secret key agreement. The local miIO protocol, fixed by the robot, has none.
crypto_password_storage_justification: The integration authenticates no users (Home Assistant does). It keeps the Xiaomi account password in the config entry to renew the cloud session, as documented in SECURITY.md and docs/ASSURANCE.md.
crypto_random_justification: Nonces for the cloud signature and miIO request ids come from Python's secrets module.
crypto_weaknesses_justification: MD5 (miIO key derivation and checksum) and RC4 (Xiaomi cloud fields) are used only because the robot and Xiaomi's servers require them; no mechanism of the project's own choice uses a weak algorithm.
delivery_mitm_justification: Releases and the repository are only distributed over HTTPS from GitHub (HACS downloads from there).
delivery_unsigned_justification: Nothing is fetched over HTTP. HACS installs from GitHub over HTTPS, and each release's dreame_vacuum_3d.zip carries its signed build-provenance attestation (https://github.com/dortizesquivel/dreame-vacuum-3d/blob/main/SECURITY.md#verifying-a-release).
vulnerabilities_fixed_60_days_justificat: No known unpatched vulnerabilities; CodeQL runs in CI and Dependabot keeps the dependencies current.
static_analysis_justification: CodeQL (Python, JavaScript and the workflows) with the security-extended queries on every pull request, on main and weekly: https://github.com/dortizesquivel/dreame-vacuum-3d/blob/main/.github/workflows/codeql.yml. ruff with bandit's rules and mypy too.
static_analysis_common_vulnerabilities_j: CodeQL's security-extended queries and ruff's bandit rules look for common vulnerabilities (XSS, injection, stack-trace exposure, unsafe workflows…).
static_analysis_fixed_justification: ruff's bandit rules have no open findings; CodeQL findings are fixed before merging.
static_analysis_often_justification: On every commit to a pull request and to main, and weekly.
dynamic_analysis_justification: Property-based fuzzing with Hypothesis of the miIO codec, the cloud crypto and the map decoder (tests/protocol, tests/device/test_map.py), and Playwright browser tests of the card, on every pull request and before every release.
dynamic_analysis_enable_assertions_justi: The tests run with assertions: pytest asserts, Hypothesis properties and Playwright expectations.
dynamic_analysis_fixed_justification: No exploitable vulnerabilities have been found by fuzzing; the decoder raises only MapError on hostile input, which the fuzz tests check.
test_continuous_integration_justificatio: GitHub Actions runs the Python, card and browser tests on every pull request and on main: https://github.com/dortizesquivel/dreame-vacuum-3d/blob/main/.github/workflows/ci.yml
no_leaked_credentials_justification: No credentials in the repository: GitHub secret scanning and push protection are enabled, recorded cloud replies in the tests use fake tokens, and the release deploy key lives in Actions secrets.
english_justification: Documentation, code, issues and pull requests are in English (the UI is in English and Spanish).
hardening_justification: Redacted diagnostics, a bounds-checked map decoder, room names rendered as text in the card, three.js bundled (no CDN), errors that never reach entity states, actions pinned to commits, read-only CI tokens and signed releases.
crypto_used_network_justification: Cloud requests use HTTPS; the local miIO traffic is encrypted with the device token, as the robot's protocol requires.
crypto_tls12_justification: Requests go through a Home Assistant aiohttp session, whose SSL context (Python 3.14 defaults) only allows TLS 1.2 or later.
crypto_certificate_verification_justific: Home Assistant's aiohttp session verifies TLS certificates, and the integration never turns that off.
crypto_verification_private_justificatio: The Xiaomi credentials and session are sent only over HTTPS with the certificate verified.
installation_common_justification: Installed, updated and removed through HACS, or by copying one folder into custom_components: the usual way for Home Assistant integrations.
dco_justification: https://github.com/dortizesquivel/dreame-vacuum-3d/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#sign-off-dco: commits are signed off with the Developer Certificate of Origin 1.1 (git commit -s).
bus_factor_justification: One maintainer today. https://github.com/dortizesquivel/dreame-vacuum-3d/blob/main/GOVERNANCE.md describes how co-maintainers join and the continuity plan.
documentation_roadmap_justification: https://github.com/dortizesquivel/dreame-vacuum-3d/blob/main/ROADMAP.md: plans until the end of 2027 and what is not planned.
documentation_security_justification: https://github.com/dortizesquivel/dreame-vacuum-3d/blob/main/SECURITY.md (what the integration stores, talks to and exports) and https://github.com/dortizesquivel/dreame-vacuum-3d/blob/main/docs/ASSURANCE.md
documentation_current_justification: CONTRIBUTING.md requires the docs to follow every change; the README's demo GIF comes from the demo with a simulated robot.
documentation_achievements_justification: The README shows the OpenSSF Scorecard badge next to the CI ones: https://github.com/dortizesquivel/dreame-vacuum-3d#readme
accessibility_best_practices_justificati: The card follows the Home Assistant theme (light and dark), uses real buttons with aria-label and aria-pressed, and respects reduced motion; the landing page does the same.
internationalization_justification: Texts are translated (translations/en.json and es.json for the integration, the card's string table for the card) and follow each user's language; dates and numbers are formatted with Intl for the user's locale.
sites_password_security_justification: The project sites (GitHub and GitHub Pages) do not store passwords for external users.
maintenance_or_update_justification: Users update through HACS to the latest release; the changelog and release notes describe every change, and versions follow SemVer.
vulnerability_report_credit_justificatio: No vulnerabilities have been reported in the last 12 months; SECURITY.md commits to crediting reporters in the advisory.
coding_standards_justification: https://github.com/dortizesquivel/dreame-vacuum-3d/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#style, ruff's and mypy's configuration in pyproject.toml and ESLint's recommended rules (card/eslint.config.js).
coding_standards_enforced_justification: ruff check, ruff format --check, mypy and npm run lint (--max-warnings 0) run in CI, so any finding fails the pull request.
build_preserve_debug_justification: No native binaries; the Python ships as source, and the card's source is in card/src next to its bundle.
build_non_recursive_justification: No make-style build system; esbuild bundles the card in one step.
build_repeatable_justification: Reproducible: checking out a release tag and running python scripts/release.py package gives a byte-identical dreame_vacuum_3d.zip (https://github.com/dortizesquivel/dreame-vacuum-3d/blob/main/SECURITY.md#verifying-a-release), and CI checks the card bundle rebuilds identically.
installation_standard_variables_justific: Not installed into a POSIX file system: Home Assistant loads it from /config/custom_components.
installation_development_quick_justifica: pip install -r requirements_test.txt and pytest; in card/, npm ci, npm test and npm run demo: https://github.com/dortizesquivel/dreame-vacuum-3d#development
external_dependencies_justification: manifest.json (no runtime requirements beyond Home Assistant), requirements_test.txt for the tests, card/package.json and card/package-lock.json for three.js and the card's tools.
dependency_monitoring_justification: Dependabot monthly updates for pip, npm and the GitHub Actions.
updateable_reused_components_justificati: three.js is pinned in card/package.json, where Dependabot updates it; npm run build rebuilds the bundle and CI fails if it is stale.
interfaces_current_justification: Current Home Assistant APIs, tested against Home Assistant 2026.10; Dependabot keeps the test harness and tools up to date.
automated_integration_testing_justificat: The Python, card and browser tests run on every pull request and every push to main: https://github.com/dortizesquivel/dreame-vacuum-3d/blob/main/.github/workflows/ci.yml
regression_tests_added50_justification: Most bug fixes come with a regression test in the same commit (for example the stuck return to the dock, the missing first map frame, the history re-check, the MIoT and miIO hardening).
test_statement_coverage80_justification: CI enforces at least 95 % of lines and branches of the integration (pyproject.toml).
test_policy_mandated_justification: https://github.com/dortizesquivel/dreame-vacuum-3d/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md: new functionality must come with tests.
input_validation_justification: Service calls are validated by their schemas, the config flow by its selectors, cloud and MIoT replies are checked before use, and the map decoder checks sizes against the header; see https://github.com/dortizesquivel/dreame-vacuum-3d/blob/main/docs/ASSURANCE.md
crypto_algorithm_agility_justification: The integration chooses no cryptography of its own: it speaks the protocols the robot and Xiaomi impose (miIO: AES-128-CBC with the 16-byte device token; Xiaomi cloud: HTTPS plus SHA-256-derived RC4 keys on request fields), with the Python standard library and the cryptography package. The algorithms are fixed by those protocols.
crypto_credential_agility_justification: The Xiaomi credentials and the device token are kept in the config entry, separate from the code, and can be changed by reconfiguring or reauthenticating.
signed_releases_justification: Releases are signed with Sigstore build-provenance attestations (.sigstore.json and .intoto.jsonl attached to each release); verify with gh attestation verify dreame_vacuum_3d.zip --repo dortizesquivel/dreame-vacuum-3d (https://github.com/dortizesquivel/dreame-vacuum-3d/blob/main/SECURITY.md#verifying-a-release).
version_tags_signed_justification: Tags are annotated and created by the release workflow; the release files themselves are signed.
maintained_justification: Actively maintained: regular releases and pull requests. https://github.com/dortizesquivel/dreame-vacuum-3d/pulls?q=is%3Apr
